purpose: Define the Expose monitor for Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine activity as a read-only provenance-backed projection of automation definitions and runtime execution state.

topics.name: Automation Monitor
topics.purpose: Define the Expose monitor for Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine activity as a read-only provenance-backed projection of automation definitions and runtime execution state.

semantics.readonly_rule: Monitor observation does not mutate automation state.
semantics.definition_state_rule: Canonical definitions and runtime state are displayed separately.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed chain retains exact Event/Trigger/Runner/Routine identities.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing monitor grants no run/edit/cancel authority.
semantics.action_rule: Any run/cancel/edit control invokes a separate explicit canonical operation with normal authorization.
semantics.layout_rule: Timeline/graph layout is projection only and never creates execution order.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.

prose.summary: Define the Expose monitor for Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine activity as a read-only provenance-backed projection of automation definitions and runtime execution state.
